name: RadioGroup
summary: Mutually exclusive single choice from 2+ options. Round 16 px ring per option (md). Built on Radix RadioGroup; uses .lumen-radio shell.

name.description: Form field name. All radios in the group share it.

keyboard: Tab — focus the group; lands on the checked option (or first option if none checked)
Space — select (when wrapped from auto-select on focus)
rules: Always wrap in a <fieldset> with a visible <legend>.
All radios share a name — Radix handles this internally; consumer passes name on the Root.
Touch target extends to the label.

do: Use RadioGroup for ≥ 2 mutually exclusive options where all options should be visible at once.
Always provide a label per option.
Default to no preselection unless there's a true 'safe default' the user would want.
dont: Don't use RadioGroup for booleans — use Switch or Checkbox.
Don't use RadioGroup for ≥ 7 options — use Select or Combobox.
Don't preselect an option that costs the user money (insurance upsell, paid plan).

changelog.note: Initial release. Adopts .lumen-radio shell. Replaces the v0.5 dual implementation drift (DIY radio in inputs.tsx vs unused shadcn Radix radio-group).
